newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money market rates remain at high levels.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money market rates remain at high levels.

text.p: Pakistani money market rates remained at high levels on Thursday owing to a paucity of funds, dealers said.
Overnight market trades were dealt within a narrow range of 19 to 20 percent, a dealer at KASB & Co said.
Heavy amounts were traded between 19.50 and 19.90 percent, he said. Four-day repos were also struck around 19 percent because of the fund shortage.
The market closed short and banks were seen queeing at the central bank discount window for amounts close to 1.5 billion rupees, he said. -- Ibrahim Khan 9221-5685192
